verdict.rationale: Orama is a search, vector and answer-engine platform with a cloud service, so background automations are a plausible axis. However, nothing in the evidence documents scheduled, triggered or autonomous background jobs. The only nearby item describes a JavaScript runtime for building agents and custom business logic, which is a developer building block rather than a shipped automation capability. The mention of data sources with different update schedules describes how a user organizes data, not automation the product runs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
